title: PFMI Proportional Self-Assessment Scorer
description: Scores a payment system operator’s or overseer’s self-assessment against the 24 CPMI-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures (Apr 2012) or, for an authority role, the 5 responsibilities of relevant authorities, on the assessment methodology’s four-level rating scale plus not_applicable (Dec 2012, paras 3.18 and 3.21), with this tool’s illustrative proportional tiers (systemic, prominent, small; not a CPMI-IOSCO classification), a gap register sorted by severity then id, a date-ordered action plan, and an optional linked fast payment system governance module (CPMI Oct 2024, section 4). Values only; verifies structure and scope, never evidence.

tier.description: systemic, prominent or small (operator role; illustrative tiers).

linked_system.description: Adds the linked fast payment system governance module (CPMI Oct 2024, section 4); operator role only.

ratings.description: Per-principle (operator) or per-responsibility (authority) entries { id, rating, evidence_ref?, target_date? }. Rating is observed, broadly_observed, partly_observed, not_observed or not_applicable.
